templatesPendingBanner: This engine sends on WhatsApp — approve at least one template below before it can go live.

amendDialog.heading: Amend the brief
amendDialog.description: The brief grows by amendment — this is appended, the original is never rewritten. It applies at each person's next natural check-in.
amendDialog.placeholder: e.g. Also mention the new weekend batch starting next month.

autonomy.title: Auto-send
autonomy.noAutoSend: No channel sends on its own. Every message waits for you in the task inbox.

badge.off: Auto-send off — you check each message

autonomy.rampingHintChannel_one: You check every {{channel}} message for now. Approve {{count}} more and {{channel}} starts sending on its own.
autonomy.rampingHintChannel_other: You check every {{channel}} message for now. Approve {{count}} more and {{channel}} starts sending on its own.

archiveDialog.title: Archive this engine?
archiveDialog.description: It stops deciding and sending for good. Tasks already in the inbox and past messages stay.

status.title: Status & audience
status.footnote: Pause stops all messages. “Stop auto-send” keeps drafting messages for you to check.

noPeople.title: No one is in this engine yet
noPeople.text: Add the people from the batches and lists you picked. Nothing is sent until you activate the engine.

activateDialog.descriptionAuto: It starts contacting people now. Channels set to send on their own will send without asking once their trial is done; everything else waits for you in the task inbox.
activateDialog.descriptionCopilot: It starts drafting messages now. Every message waits for you in the task inbox; nothing goes out without your approval.
activateDialog.noPeople: No one has been added yet, so there is nobody to contact. Press “Add people now” first.
